question: Who among the following travelled from Bithoor to Kalpi, Delhi and Lucknow in 1857 to rally the support of native princes for an uprising against the British?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nana Saheb**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nana Saheb**, also known as **Dhondu Pant**, was one of the prominent leaders of the **Indian Rebellion of 1857**.
 
• He travelled to places like **Bithoor, Kalpi, Delhi, and Lucknow** to rally the support of native princes and leaders against British rule.
 
• He was the adopted son of Peshwa Baji Rao II</strong&g
